name: Beetronics FX
author: Tone Zone
description: Hand-crafted, bee-themed pedals inspired by Beetronics FX: envelope filter, octave and harmonic fuzzes, an OD / fuzz blender, octave stutter, overdrive, harmonizer modulation and a bass octave fuzz. Domed enclosures with honeycomb, dripping honey and gold-on-black plates.
